mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a human right that should be provided to all human beings solely by reasons of being human."
Education is a human right that should be provided to all human beings solely by reasons of being human.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the broad programme of activities designed by the government or school in order to help achieve the general goals or objectives of education."
Curriculum is the broad programme of activities designed by the government or school in order to help achieve the general goals or objectives of education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the general assembly of all graduate members of the university staff, both academic and non-academic."
Congregation is the general assembly of all graduate members of the university staff, both academic and non-academic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a joint effort of all the stakeholders (government, university authority, religious leaders, students and parents)."
Eradicating cultism in Nigerian universities is a joint effort of all the stakeholders (government, university authority, religious leaders, students and parents).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a principle upon which the higher education system normally operates and through which operational stability and actualization of goals of the higher educational institutions are ensured."
Autonomy is a principle upon which the higher education system normally operates and through which operational stability and actualization of goals of the higher educational institutions are ensured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chairman of the council."
The pro- chancellor is the chairman of the council.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a worldwide phenomenon in the academic circles and higher institutions."
Academic freedom is a worldwide phenomenon in the academic circles and higher institutions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most discussed issues in the Nigerian educational system today."
Standard is the most discussed issues in the Nigerian educational system today.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the planned and systematic actions (deemed) as necessary to provide adequate confidence that a product or service will satisfy given requirements for quality (Borahan and Ziarati, 2002)."

Quality assurance refers to the planned and systematic actions (deemed) as necessary to provide adequate confidence that a product or service will satisfy given requirements for quality (Borahan and Ziarati, 2002).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most offenders in the quality assurance drive in the Nigerian higher education."
State-owned universities are the most offenders in the quality assurance drive in the Nigerian higher education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the keyword that should drive the ideology of any curriculum content and practice that can benefit a society."
Relevance is the keyword that should drive the ideology of any curriculum content and practice that can benefit a society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those ones established between 1991 to date."
The fourth generation universities are those ones established between 1991 to date.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the quality of the informal learning environment that students experience in the university community."
The Student Affairs Division is responsible for the quality of the informal learning environment that students experience in the university community.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Chief Administrative Officer of the university and is responsible to the Vice-Chancellor for the day to day administration of the affairs (except financial affairs) of the University."

The Registrar is the Chief Administrative Officer of the university and is responsible to the Vice-Chancellor for the day to day administration of the affairs (except financial affairs) of the University.
fib: ______ refers to widespread migration of academic staff from the institutions in the country to overseas institutions or equivalent institutions where their services are better rewarded.
Brain-drain
Brain-drain refers to widespread migration of academic staff from the institutions in the country to overseas institutions or equivalent institutions where their services are better rewarded.
______ are the recipients of the services of higher institutions.
stakeholders
The stakeholders are the recipients of the services of higher institutions.
______ is the supreme governing authority of the university.
governing council
The governing council is the supreme governing authority of the university.
______ is the Dean who is elected for a specified period of time from among the professors in the particular faculty, while the provost heads the College.
Chairman of the Faculty Board
The Chairman of the Faculty Board is the Dean who is elected for a specified period of time from among the professors in the particular faculty, while the provost heads the College.
______ are the academic staff and students.
active agents
The active agents are the academic staff and students.
______ is the Chief Executive and Academic Head of the university.
Vice- Chancellor
The Vice- Chancellor is the Chief Executive and Academic Head of the university.
______ is a general rule of good financial management and utilization.
Prudent and calculated spending
Prudent and calculated spending is a general rule of good financial management and utilization.
______ is the President in the case of a Federal Universities and the Governor in the case of a State Universities.
visitor
The visitor is the President in the case of a Federal Universities and the Governor in the case of a State Universities.
______ is the Chairman of Senate and all its statutory committees.
Vice-Chancellor
The Vice-Chancellor is the Chairman of Senate and all its statutory committees.
______ is the Chief Financial Officer of the university and is responsible to the Vice- Chancellor for the day-to-day administration and control of the financial affairs of the university.
Bursar
The Bursar is the Chief Financial Officer of the university and is responsible to the Vice- Chancellor for the day-to-day administration and control of the financial affairs of the university.
______ is a community of scholars, free to pursue knowledge without undue interference from anywhere.
Higher education
Higher education is a community of scholars, free to pursue knowledge without undue interference from anywhere.
______ is the control by the federal government through the National University Commission (NUC), a body charged with the coordination of university management in the country.
external dimension
The external dimension is the control by the federal government through the National University Commission (NUC), a body charged with the coordination of university management in the country.
______ means different things to different people and it has been defined in many ways.
Accountability
Accountability means different things to different people and it has been defined in many ways.
______ is the management of men and women with most highly developed and developing minds and intellects.
University governance
University governance is the management of men and women with most highly developed and developing minds and intellects.
